mentions.name: DoneThat
mentions.description: An AI work capture app with a proactive coach: it takes a screenshot every few minutes, analyzes what the user is working on, identifies task blocks, and starts a chat when appropriate based on the user's intentions, such as nudging them out of a rabbit hole, suggesting a break, or helping with a task. It supports bringing your own local or remote LLM, otherwise processes screenshots with Gemini without storing any data, and is in beta via a 'proactive chat' setting.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am right now building a proactive coach on top of my AI work capture app. Concept is very simple: It takes a screenshot every few minutes and analyzes what you're working on. From there it identifies task blocks, and checks if it should start a chat based on your intentions (eg to tell you to move out of your rabbit hole, take a break, help with a task, ...)

mentions.description: A fully automated work tracker that takes screenshots every few minutes and reconstructs a calendar of what actually happened, with goals for how much time to spend on topics and a social feed. Planned to become an AI coach. It never stores raw data, supports bringing your own Gemini key, and includes other privacy features; the builder is exploring making it work in team settings without sacrificing privacy.
